title: Observatoire astral
style: Soft painterly stadium diorama, original design: no text, logos, ball emblems or recognisable venue. Crowd as a soft colour mass. Values one to two steps darker than the pixel-art creatures, calm and low-contrast behind them (stands band and landmark base), detail and the brightest accents kept to the upper sky and the edges.
plate: Deep violet night with drifting nebulae and a dense star field; a ringed planet hangs in the upper sky with a small moon, and an observatory dome with a glowing slit rises to one side. Colonnaded galleries with brass rails, orrery lamp posts.
court: Midnight lapis stone with gold constellation inlays, concentric orbit rings and fine star specks, pale gold markings and an inlaid six-rhombus sigil.
value: Dark sky with one bright disc and its ring off-centre, speckled stars.
